required_clarifications_before_source_fr.resolution: Inherit fixed tie rule: forecast 0 is non-harmful for class, zero-cell for policy. State OOF excludes image only from selector calibration and does not establish held-out original SR-model training images.

checked.finding: H1 entails within model-scale-band harm separation. Counterexamples lower positive versus upper negative remain in cohort. H2 demands pooled detection, within-cell AUC and MSE policy benefit; no-match/no-new-cohort after failed gate is explicit.

Lower target is saved LR y, so its reconstruction error is observable at deployment. Upper calibration labels are permitted only after lower feature freezing. Previously seen calibration is correctly retrospective, not a blinded test.
Eight image-level folds hold both scales and all bands out jointly, preventing same-image target label sharing across cells. Standardization, ridge and scale-band median must be fold-local.

Scale2 and4 lower targets64 and32, lower inputs32 and8. Shave2 and1 retains same physical fractional region as HR128 shave4. Pixel-frequency boundaries equal across corresponding tasks and multiplier s equal; discrete FFT bins differ as disclosed.

Native cell2/n changes between upper and lower tasks. This tests transfer at equal nominal upscaling factor, not identical physical frequencies or identical neural response. Second downsampling alters texture/aliasing; failure would reject transfer, not all content-based prediction.
Original magnitude/spectrum and directional ridge, proxy, static choice and scale-band median give meaningful controls. Within-cell AUC specifically prevents a benefit from only scale/band grouping.

Both fixed candidates/models reported separately. Image-cluster CI conditional on fixed OOF forecasts cannot claim generalization coverage or account fully for overlapping training folds; protocol states this limitation.
